recognitionRules: Use dark slate header bands, pale result cells and amber editable entry cells.
Keep Overview, Sessions and Definitions as separate reading functions.
Show counts and percentages with explicit denominators.
Retain blank, missing-input and no-capacity states rather than converting unknowns to zero.
Preserve the source conditional state colors and accompanying labels only when their recorded condition applies; do not turn exception, venue or validation colors into universal logo accents.

principles: Name the choice, its owner and the condition that makes it complete.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Count the places. Check the demand. Make room deliberately.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.

Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.

source.nameStatus: Editorial name derived for this reusable identity; source specimen names remain fictional.
source.observationBoundary: Source values and component names are observed; identity naming, verbal examples and reusable rules are editorial design choices. Rendered application QA is tracked separately.

editorialSource.overview: A three-sheet capacity workbook: Overview compares recorded and hypothetical figures, Sessions holds 12 entry rows and guarded calculations, and Definitions explains the terms. Arial 11 pt is used for cells and bold 17 pt titles appear at A2. Dark #243746 headers, pale #EFF3F6 results and amber #FFF2CC input cells distinguish roles.
invariants: The amber input fill spans the Sessions entry area, including A5:C16 and scenario-seat cells G5:G16; it is not limited to the prefilled first three rows.
Overview formulas reference Sessions totals, including B7=Sessions!B18 and E7=Sessions!G18. The scenario changes capacity while enrollment stays recorded.
Sessions formulas retain blank, Missing input and No capacity outcomes as appropriate. The local PDF uses LiberationSans resources although workbook styles request Arial.
adaptationChecks: If the 12 entry rows change, update row-18 totals, formulas, validations, conditional formatting and Overview references together.
Exercise blank capacity, zero capacity and overbooking cases; verify unknowns do not become misleading zeroes.
Check edited labels against Overview A=36/C=4/D=30 and Definitions B=73 character widths, and replace the fictional organization label with supported facts.

visualFidelityReview.scope: Native rendered cover/desktop preview reviewed on 104-identity contact boards; discrepancies opened individually. Native XML corroborates exact values. This does not claim every page was visually inspected.
visualFidelityReview.logoBoundary: The authored brand wordmark and symbol are new editorial proposals unless separately identified as preserved source geometry; supporting native artwork and functional color roles are not replaced by the new logo.
